$comment: The canon's own stamp. role canon-home means the surface and overlay checks do not apply - this repo ships rules, not a product - and its digest is current by definition.

exemptions.reason: Contrib records are frozen historical accounts of a survey, not living prose. check-rules.ps1 excludes them from the style check for the same reason; fixing their typography would rewrite a record of what was found.
Same as SZA-STYLE01: contrib records are frozen.
